question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"sequenced."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sequenced" **means arranging items in a particular order or sequence. (वस्तुओं को किसी विशेष क्रम या अनुक्रम में व्यवस्थित करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Trainee librarians decide how a set of misfiled cards could be **sequenced**__.*
 
 
 
• In the given context, it refers to filling in the blank with an appropriate option.
 
• The word is grammatically correct and fits the sentence structure.
 
• It conveys the idea that the blank needs to be filled in with a particular order or sequence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

I know these authors to __be__ outstanding individuals and remarkable teachers and consultants and have even __seen__ them work their magic in training seminars, but I didn’t know if they __could__ take this complex topic and fit into a book. They did. I __encourage__ you to really dig into this material, to pause and think deeply about each part and how the parts are __**sequenced**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (recalled)** means remembering something from the past. (अतीत की कोई बात (तथ्‍य, घटना, क्रिया आदि) याद करना)
 
• **Option 3 (jumbled) **means mixed up or disordered. (वस्‍तुओं को बेतरतब ढंग से मिला देना)
 
• **Option 4 (tinkered) **means making small changes or adjustments to something. (बिना सही अभ्‍यास या जानकारी के किसी चीज़ की मरम्‍मत करने लगना; ठोका-पीटी)
